meta.caveat: Efficiency is observed farm power over the sum of per-turbine curves at the most-upwind turbine's reference speed. With reference='power' that speed is inverted from metered power, which removes the nacelle-anemometer calibration spread but inherits whatever the per-turbine curves got wrong. It still absorbs curtailment, icing, availability and genuine per-turbine performance differences, so it is an upper bound on the wake loss, not an independent measurement of it.

decay_calibration.note: Fitted on the validation window only. The comparison absorbs reference-group and instrument effects, so the fitted k is an effective constant for this site, not a physical measurement of wake decay.
